target_customer: Discrete and process manufacturers such as glass, beverage and food plants
problem: Production line stoppages and defects are noticed late. Cerrion uses video AI on existing CCTV cameras to detect problems in real time.
business_model: B2B SaaS and deployment subscription per line or plant
product_category: Industrial computer vision and video AI

founders.name: Karim Saleh
previous_startups: Unicorn Labs (built MVPs for 30 plus startups)
founders.background_notes: Former captain of Egypt's national water polo team per YC page.

founders.name: Nikolay Kobyshev
education: ETH Zurich, PhD and MSc in computer vision

founders.name: Michael (surname not given)
founders.background_notes: Named as a co-founder in the YC launch post per the YC page; no surname or background given.

competitors.name: Elementary
competitors.what: AI vision inspection platform for manufacturing
competitors.traction_then: Customers in manufacturing; Series B announced December 2021
competitors.funding_then: 30M USD Series B led by Tiger Global, 47.5M USD total

technical_complexity.rationale: Learning normal process behavior from standard CCTV, real-time anomaly detection at 500 bottles per minute and on-site processing is hard computer vision work.

defensibility.rationale: Plant deployments with PLC integration and per-line learned models create lock-in; the base vision techniques are widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Machine vision incumbents focused on dedicated cameras; no acquisition of Cerrion found by 2026.

market_need_then: Manufacturers lose large sums to downtime and scrap, and AI inspection startups were raising growth rounds in 2021 and 2022.

branding.name_origin: Bilanz reports the founders nearly named the company 'Cerrione' after an Italian village in Piedmont.

identity.voice_and_tone: B2B industrial tone with ROI proof points on the site

branding.community_and_virality: B2B trade and VC press (tech.eu, Bilanz, food industry outlets); no consumer community.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive coined name, but with no documented brand effect on a B2B enterprise sales motion.

outcome_analysis: Cerrion, founded in Zurich in December 2021 by ETH computer vision experts, entered YC in Summer 2022, raised 5M USD in September 2024 and an 18M USD Series A led by Creandum in November 2025. Customers like Stoelzle and Sisecam expanded from one plant to group-wide rollouts with reported ROI of 6x to 8x, which supports real product-market fit in glass and beverage manufacturing.
notes: The September 2024 round is labelled seed here because the source says only 'funding'; stage is inferred, and one listing mentions a 2022 seed that no source confirms. The November 2025 round is 18M USD, about 15.6M EUR. Founding year 2021 per YC and Bilanz (December 2021); Vestbee says 2020. Instrumental (Series C February 2022) was seen only in a search summary, so not listed. Technical founder labels for Michael are unknown.
